trust.title: What Makes Our Traceability Different
trust.farm: Single-origin from our 35-hectare farm in Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire — not mixed lots from unknown sources
trust.batch: Unique batch IDs tracked in Farm OS from harvest to delivery — not a paper ledger
trust.public: Publicly verifiable — anyone with the batch ID can check. No login required.
trust.certs: Certifications verified and displayed per batch — not just claims on a website
trust.signature: Tamper-proof digital signature — every batch is cryptographically signed and verifiable
trust.ctaBody: Every wholesale order includes Farm OS traceability with digital signatures at no extra cost. Your buyers can verify origin, quality, certifications, and data integrity — just like this page.
trust.originDesc: GPS coordinates recorded at harvest from our farm in Odienné — verifiable on any map
trust.batchDesc: Each batch receives a unique digital ID tracked at every stage in our custom operating system
trust.transparentDesc: Anyone with the batch ID can verify this information — buyers, customs, investors, and regulators

farmOsRecord.title: Farm OS Record
farmOsRecord.note: Data pulled directly from Farm OS. Tamper-proof digital signature confirms this record has not been altered since signing.
farmOsRecord.signatureExplanation: Our digital signatures use cryptographic technology to prove that this batch data is authentic and has not been tampered with. When you see a verified signature, you can trust that the information you're viewing is exactly what was recorded in Farm OS — not something generated after the fact.
farmOsRecord.verifyInstructions: Enter the verification code above on our public verification page to confirm this record's authenticity. Anyone can verify — no login required.

verify.title: Record Verification
verify.explanation: This verification code confirms that a Farm OS record was digitally signed and has not been altered. The signature is cryptographically tied to the original batch data.
